per_candidate.id: s2:The Late-time Radio Behavior of Gamma-ray Burst Afterglows: Testing the Standard

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the discrepancies in dust content and dust-to-metal ratios in the BAT6 sample or their influence on X-ray afterglow properties of GRBs. They are related to GRB afterglows or dust in galaxies but do not address the specific question posed.
